name: Psychoport Trigger
body:
Discipline Psychoportation (Teleportation); Level Nomad 5

MANIFESTING

Display Material
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Power Points 9

DESCRIPTION

You specify a situation that triggers your automatic manifestation of a psychoport, taking you to a predetermined location. You must know the psychoport power and have sufficient power points to manifest it when the specified situation occurs.

The psychoport trigger goes off on the initiative count immediately after the specified situation occurs, even if you are flat-footed or you have already taken your turn in the current round. The specified situation can be described in general terms or specific terms.
